{{Top|leg}}
The '''Qel-Droma Holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Around the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] studied the Qel-Droma Holocron and obtained information from it regarding the [[Dark Reaper]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that had been deployed during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
